author: Kevin B. Liu
description: The Deploy screen's mode pictures (brand-ui S3, 245 and 246, the Premiere direction's 04-deploy page): each core mode's picture, a 640x360 cut of the approved in-engine still the direction chose for it; each other mode's tile, Proving Ground among them, a 480x270 cut of a battle frame of that mode with the HUD hidden (the media lane's captures: the rows with `capture`; tools/deploy-mode-art.mjs keeps them); and the Campaign tab's briefing plates, op-0N-1280, one Scene Studio still per operation; and each mode's plate background on the Deploy screen, <id>-1600 (1600x900, the `-panel` rows: the core modes' a cut of their card stills, the others the media lane's HUD-free battle frames; owner 2026-10-26).
generatedBy: the core cards: ffmpeg (scale lanczos) + cwebp -q 80 -m 6; the tiles and plates: the media lane (shots/media-r5/landing-r6/site-all/publish-stills.py); the core plate backgrounds: ffmpeg (scale lanczos) + cwebp -q 70 -m 6
